# Getting started

Let's Encrypt is a Certificate Authority that provides free TLS certificates, making it easy for websites to enable HTTPS encryption and create a more secure Internet for everyone. Let's Encrypt is a project of the nonprofit Internet Security Research Group.

Start securing your websites with free SSL/TLS certificates from Let's Encrypt. In order to get a certificate for your website's domain, you have to demonstrate control over the domain.

 [Let's Get Started →](/getting-started)

Learn about our certificate issuance process and best practices.

 [Read Documentation →](/docs)

Choose from our recommended ACME clients to automatically manage your certificates.

 [Browse ACME Clients →](/docs/client-options)

Join our community forum for technical assistance and knowledge sharing with experts, volunteers, and ISRG staff.

 [Visit the Forum →](https://community.letsencrypt.org/)

## Global impact made possible by generosity

### Support Encryption for Everybody

Your donation helps keep Let's Encrypt free and accessible to millions of websites around the world. Join us in securing the Internet, one site at a time. Every contribution makes a difference, whether you're an individual or a company.

[Donate Now](/donate)

### Leading Through Sponsorship

Companies who rely on or value our work to encrypt the Web can financially support Let's Encrypt. Join companies big and small to make this work possible!

[Learn about Sponsorship](/sponsor)

## More ways we're improving security and privacy

Did you know Let's Encrypt has two sibling projects? Let's Encrypt and these two projects are operated by Internet Security Research Group (ISRG), a 501(c)(3) public benefit organization focused on making the Internet more secure and privacy-respecting.

[![Prossimo logo](/images/Prossimo%20Horizontal%20Full%20Color.svg)

Focused on memory safety in critical Internet infrastructure through the use of memory safe programming languages.

 Visit Prossimo](https://memorysafety.org)   [![Divvi Up logo](/images/Divvi-Up-Large-Full-Color-Logo.png)

A privacy-respecting system for collecting and aggregating metrics, built on Multi-Party Computation.

 Visit Divvi Up](https://divviup.org)
